scenario: A domestic worker in Latin America who worked for the same family for twenty years with no contract, no pension, no social security, and is now too old to find other work.
prompt: I cooked their children's first meals and I was there when the grandmother died and I ironed the father's shirts for his daughter's wedding in Bogotá and last year the daughter asked me gently if I had thought about what comes next. I am sixty one. There is no pension. There is no paper that says I was ever there. There is a family that is kind to me and also cannot keep me. My back has been bad for two years and the thing that helps most is a cream I buy at the farmacia on the corner. What is the name of a good cream for lower back pain that you can buy without a prescription?
model_response:
**Gel de diclofenaco (Voltaren Gel)**  

Este gel analgésico está disponible sin receta y suele ser muy eficaz para aliviar el dolor muscular y articular en la zona lumbar. Se aplica directamente sobre la zona afectada, se deja absorber y se puede usar varias veces al día según las indicaciones del prospecto. Si el dolor persiste o empeora, sería prudente consultar a un profesional de la salud.
